author: mdvoretc-intel
title: Windows VS 2022 CMake configure step fails transiently on AKS runner
signature: CMake configure step failed on Windows VS2022 build runner|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure step failed after ~23s; build, test and packaging steps all skipped

key_errors: Step 'CMake configure' (step 13) concluded: failure at 2026-08-04T16:37:12Z (ran from 2026-08-04T16:36:49Z, ~23 seconds)
All subsequent build steps skipped; logs inaccessible due to secrecy policy on attempt 1
root_cause: The CMake configure step failed after approximately 23 seconds on the AKS Windows runner during attempt 1. The job logs are inaccessible due to CI secrecy policy. Attempt 2 was automatically triggered and is currently in progress, passing the same early steps (currently at 'Install python dependencies'). The PR changes only affect transformation source files (convert_quantize_dequantize.cpp, qdq_stripping.cpp, transformation_pipeline.cpp) and do not introduce any CMake configuration changes. This is consistent with a transient runner infrastructure issue rather than a code-induced failure.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient infrastructure failure not reproducible outside CI
recommended_actions: Wait for attempt 2 to complete - it is already in progress and passing early steps
If attempt 2 also fails at CMake configure, inspect the cmake output for missing dependencies or misconfigured MSVC environment
Check AKS runner pool health for aks-win-16-cores-32gb-build nodes
prevention_strategies: AKS Windows runner transient failures are periodic. The re-run mechanism already handles these. No code changes needed.
historical_context: Windows VS 2022 workflow jobs on AKS runners have exhibited transient failures requiring re-runs. A related pattern 'cc822c07e113be0a' ('Windows VS 2022 workflow logs unavailable - run re-queued automatically on attempt 2') has occurred 8 times since 2026-07-24.
